morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来人名整词记忆；名字中的 -ette 不作为马来语后缀分析。正文首字母大写；IPA 为常见英语读音，法语读音可为 /ʒa.nɛt/，具体以本人读法为准。词包未提供音节划分与爪夷文，无已核实的马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 珍妮特，通常用作女性名字；具体中文译名与发音应尊重姓名持有者的用法。
senses.en_definition: A given name traditionally used for women, with pronunciation varying by language and bearer.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi yang lazimnya diberikan kepada perempuan; sebutannya bergantung pada bahasa dan pilihan pemilik nama.
senses.nuances: 属于人名，不能仅凭词形确定是哪一位人物。Jeanette 与 Jeannette 有拼写关联，但在证件、名册及通信中不能自行互换。拼写、用途与参考读音见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/jeanette)。词包没有 DBP 正式释义，status 为 unverified；马来语释义为编写释义。以下为自然称名组合，未作语料频次排序。

etymology.historical_story: Jeanette is a spelling variant of Jeannette, a French diminutive of Jeanne. Its history illustrates how a familiar form of a personal name can become an independent given name across languages. French and English pronunciations differ, so the written form alone does not determine how an individual bearer says it. [Jeanette](https://www.behindthename.com/name/jeanette), [Jeannette](https://www.behindthename.com/name/jeannette).
